question: What is the average total quantity across all final packaging combinations, considering only the leaf-level items within each combination after fully expanding any nested packaging relationships?
sql:
WITH RECURSIVE hierarchy AS (
    SELECT 
        p.id AS root_id,
        p.id AS current_id,
        0 AS depth,
        CAST(1.0 AS DOUBLE) AS cumulative_qty
    FROM packaging p
    WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        h.root_id,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        h.depth + 1,
        CAST(h.cumulative_qty AS DOUBLE) * CAST(pr.qty AS DOUBLE)
    FROM hierarchy h
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON h.current_id = pr.packaging_id
),
leaf_level AS (
    SELECT 
        h.root_id,
        p.id AS leaf_id,
        h.cumulative_qty AS total_qty
    FROM hierarchy h
    JOIN packaging p ON h.current_id = p.id
    WHERE p.id IN (SELECT id FROM packaging WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations))
),
total_by_root AS (
    SELECT 
        root_id,
        SUM(total_qty) AS total_leaf_qty
    FROM leaf_level
    GROUP BY root_id
)
SELECT AVG(total_leaf_qty) AS average_total_quantity
FROM total_by_root
